design_direction: Retain custom axleboxes and frame as the primary route; define bearing arrangement and guide articulation before spring saddles or brake-reaction joints.

motions.required: Rotate together; inner-ring fit and axial retention must be designed.
motions.must_not: Treat the journal as a stationary semi-trailer spindle.

motions.required: Nonrotating support with controlled fits, shoulders, seal seats, lubrication and retention.
motions.must_not: Invent clearance/preload, bore tolerance or end-cap clamp loads.

motions.required: Specified vertical travel plus angular compliance for wheelset tilt, controlled longitudinal/lateral restraint and removal retention.
motions.must_not: Assume long rigid square guides permit tilt without binding.

motions.required: Spider, cam and chamber support remain aligned to the rotating drum through allowed motions. Brake reaction closes into guide/frame without an incompatible additional constraint.
motions.must_not: Weld the stationary spider to the rotating axle, or add a rigid torque link that locks suspension motion.

motions.required: A separately retained body bearing/pivot, prescribed yaw and roll/pitch accommodation, controlled sidebearer law.
motions.must_not: Use spring travel as a substitute for truck yaw.

supplier_return_needed: Controlled bearing arrangement drawing, exact suffixes, tolerances, fits, shoulder/radius data, setting method and retention; usable bearing CAD if provided.
Rail wheel profile, back-to-back, minimum worn diameter, hub/wheel-seat geometry, material and inspection basis.
Exact delivered D1 drum pilot/bolt circle/mating face/OD/depth and chamber/cam/spider geometry plus full service/spring force-torque curves.
engineer_definition_needed: Accepted operational/fault load cases and fatigue spectrum
Axle strength/deflection and bearing load distribution
Guide tilt freedom, bush/link/liner design, brake-reaction compatibility and wheel-load response on track twist
Joint materials, tolerances, bolt/weld calculations and prototype acceptance criteria
not_all_work_blocked: Supplier-dependent parts remain held; spring/damper functional specification, complete-truck load-case model, electrical/HVAC and other independent program work can continue.
